---
title: "ocel env publish"
description: "Publish the values one infrastructure program writes, read as JSON on stdin."
---

```bash
ocel env publish [flags]
```

The input is a provider.variablestore.v1.PublishedValues in protobuf JSON, every value the publisher writes to this tier or preview environment:

```bash
{"values": [{"key": "API_KEY", "value": "…", "secret": true}]}
```

Each value is checked as `ocel env set` checks one: a secret value must be declared secret, and a plain value must not be. A value the publisher wrote before and no longer lists is removed, so publishing nothing removes everything it wrote. A value a publisher wrote is changed only by publishing again: `ocel env set` and `ocel env rm` refuse it.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--environment` | `string` |  | Use this named preview environment; requires `--preview` |
| `--preview` | `bool` | `false` | Use preview values |
| `--publisher` | `string` |  | The stable id of the program publishing these values |

Every command also takes the [global flags](/docs/cli#global-flags).

## Behaviour

- Changes state.
- Prints data on stdout. Under `--json` it prints one result envelope, whose JSON Schema `ocel schema env publish` prints.
